title: UL-02 — Challenge: Private S3 data controls
scenario: You inherit a private S3 bucket used for workbook data. Add a `sensitive/` prefix with sample content, briefly enable Macie to capture pricing for classification, then disable Macie. Do not repeat the GL-02 step sequence.
acceptanceCriteria: Name the resource you create `workbook-ul02-<account-id>` (or reuse your tagged GL-02 bucket and record its name in your notes).
A second prefix `sensitive/` exists with at least one object under the same tagged bucket (new or reused).
Amazon Macie is enabled long enough to record the per-GB classification price from official pricing; you note the estimate in your lab notes.
Macie is disabled or suspended again before teardown so ongoing Macie charges stop.
Block public access remains fully on for the bucket.
Bucket policy still requires TLS for writes.
Lifecycle rule still targets only `lab/` and not `sensitive/`.
You can list both prefixes with `aws s3 ls` and show distinct keys.
All creatable resources carry Workbook, LabId=ul-02, CreatedAt, ExpiresAt tags where the API supports tags.
No bucket ACL grants public read or write.
Teardown removes Macie-dependent settings before emptying the bucket.
Teardown deletes all object versions under both prefixes.
Teardown deletes the bucket and policy.
After teardown, `aws s3api head-bucket` fails for your bucket name.
Tagged LabId=ul-02 inventory in us-east-1 is empty.

hints.text: Macie pricing is per GB scanned; keep the scan minimal.
Pause Macie with `aws macie2 update-macie-session --status PAUSED`; confirm with get-macie-session.

solution.outline: Meets Macie-on/off, dual-prefix, and full S3 teardown with ul-02 tags.

stopChargesPanel: Disable Macie, empty both prefixes including versions, remove policy and bucket. Macie left on can accrue charges.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Uses: $Ul02Bucket (optional — set it to your GL-02 bucket name if you reused it; otherwise the next line builds workbook-ul02-<account-id>)
# Lost an ID? aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-02
if (-not $Ul02Bucket) { $Ul02Bucket = "workbook-ul02-$((aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text))" }; Write-Host "Deleting bucket: $Ul02Bucket"

if ($Ul02BucketLabId -eq 'ul-02' -or $Ul02BucketLabId -eq 'gl-02') { aws s3api delete-bucket-policy --bucket $Ul02Bucket } else { Write-Host "Skipping ${Ul02Bucket}: LabId tag is not ul-02 or gl-02" }
if ($Ul02BucketLabId -eq 'ul-02' -or $Ul02BucketLabId -eq 'gl-02') { $versions = aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket $Ul02Bucket --output json | ConvertFrom-Json }
if ($Ul02BucketLabId -eq 'ul-02' -or $Ul02BucketLabId -eq 'gl-02') { foreach ($v in $versions.Versions) { aws s3api delete-object --bucket $Ul02Bucket --key $v.Key --version-id $v.VersionId } }
if ($Ul02BucketLabId -eq 'ul-02' -or $Ul02BucketLabId -eq 'gl-02') { foreach ($m in $versions.DeleteMarkers) { aws s3api delete-object --bucket $Ul02Bucket --key $m.Key --version-id $m.VersionId } }
verification: aws macie2 get-macie-session shows status PAUSED or Macie not enabled
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-02 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-02 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-02. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-02) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
